hero.bridgeAlt: A blue arch bridge spanning two shores, with a person and a robot crossing side by side

story.title: This summer, we found the signal.
story.body: In the summer of 2026, Signal over Noise taught us to spot the signals that truly matter amid the noise of information. On October 17 in Shenzhen, we take the next step: turning the signal into a bridge — connecting people with technology, and today with tomorrow.

bridge.ariaLabel: A suspension bridge being built piece by piece
bridge.caption: THE BRIDGE BUILDS ITSELF · BUILT BY THE COMMUNITY

tracks.title: Four Bridges, Four Crossings
tracks.sub: Four parallel tracks, each a different kind of bridge. Pick one crossing — or walk them all.

agenda.title: A Day's Route Across the Bridge

cfp.title: Bring your signal onto the bridge
cfp.body: The call for proposals closed on 2026.08.31 — thanks to everyone who transmitted a signal. Reviews are underway and results will be emailed to submitters.

sponsors.title: Co-build This Bridge
sponsors.sub: Every bridge has its co-builders. Our thanks to these partners for building alongside the community.
